messages:
alex: Quick sync — we've got conflicting claims in the new launch post vs the benchmark deck. Need to prune and align messaging for webinar and inbound routing. Who can jump on a 15m?
maria: I can. Found 3 spots where we sound like 'just another endpoint': cost-first, 'easy to use', generic low-latency claim. Need more specific differentiator.
devon: +1. Suggest swap 'low latency' to an explicit metric: 'p95 50ms on dedicated' or similar. Also call out routing/fallback story.
sarah_marketing: Love that. For webinar headline we should test 'Predictable LLM economics at scale' vs 'High-performance inference across any deployment'. A/B test in email.
james_sales: For field, reps want short rebuttals vs cloud pitch: 'we give same performance without lock-in, and cheaper at 500k tokens/day'. Need one-liners.
alex: I'll draft 3 competing one-liners. Also need short battlecard bullets vs (a) cloud AI marketplaces (b) LLM-API vendors (c) infra vendors.
maria: Proposed bullets:
- vs cloud marketplaces: unified runtime + cross-region fallback, predictable SLOs
- vs LLM APIs: deterministic routing, KV caching, prefix reuse -> measurable cost delta
- vs infra vendors: managed rollout + evals, less ops burden
devon: Add a quick quant line for each. E.g. 'Up to 2x token cost reduction via caching and batching' — but careful about hard claims, prefer 'up to' with source.
sarah_marketing: For inbound routing, recommend tagging leads by claim they reacted to in webinar form field (performance/cost/compliance) -> route to different SDR script.
james_sales: Can we add 2-3 quick rebuttal soundbites for procurement questions on compliance? e.g., 'Private deployment with KMS/HSM and audit logs, enterprise SLA'.
alex: Drafted. Pasting snippets:
```
- One-liner A: Predictable LLM economics at scale — same API, more control.
- One-liner B: Production-grade inference across hosted, dedicated, private.
- Rebuttal: Our Private + KMS option meets typical procurement controls; we also offer audit log exports.
```
maria: Nice. Two requests: make the A/B variants 3 words shorter each; and add a CTA for webinar slide: 'See measured latency & unit-cost vs X'.
devon: Also create a 90s demo script focusing on routing + fallback; show degrade path to quantized model. Keep it simple: problem, action, outcome.
sarah_marketing: I'll own A/B email tests and webinar register page. Can someone drop the benchmark chart PNG into the deck? @devon
devon: Uploading now: https://redwood.docs/bench/slide3.png
james_sales: I'll get procurement 1-pagers to append. SDR script I'm prepping now.
alex: Great. Let's reconvene tomorrow 09:30am. Outcome: final battlecard bullets, 3 one-liners, 2 email variants, demo script. :rocket:
